FIXED — the drift boards.json already recorded, `partial-trigger-exists-
cursor-not-on-body`. Measured with CDP while pick mode was live: the frame
read `crosshair` and every `[data-buildrick-id]` read `crosshair`, but
`.buildrick-canvas` — the page surface BETWEEN elements, i.e. most of what
the pointer crosses — read `default`. Cause: canvasStyles sets an INLINE
`cursor: default` on that element, and an own declaration always beats an
inherited one, so the frame's `!important` could never reach it. Canvas.css
now names `.buildrick-canvas` in the pick selector; a stylesheet
`!important` does beat a plain inline style. Re-measured: crosshair on the
frame, on the canvas and on the elements.

NOT JOINED, and why:
drawer (301:2226) — the board puts its edge on `border-r`; measure.mjs
reads `borderTopColor` only, so the comparison would be against an edge
neither side draws (the live value is `currentColor`, i.e. ink). The
colour was conformed anyway; the join would measure the wrong pixel.
site page (301:2267) — 680 x 520 is the board's SAMPLE DOCUMENT, not a
spec. The live canvas is the viewport's own width at the desktop preset
(1024 here). Founder rule: board sample data is never conformed to.
